text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As we enter the new year, the academy grounds are quiet and the air is solemn, until…

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Happy! Neeeew! YEEEEAAR!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Let's train already!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Winning Ticket may be so eager that she couldn't help cutting me off, but…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: According to the schedule, today's a holiday.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: The Derby is this year, right?! It just… just makes me feel so restless!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: The more I thought about it, the less I could sit still—and before I knew it, I found myself in front of your room!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Winning Ticket's eyes shine bright with enthusiasm as she talks.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It would be a waste not to let her make use of that momentum, but how exactly…

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: So like, that's when I thought of it! A special New Year's training scheme that'll bring us oodles of good fortune!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: I call it the Lucky Symbol Swoop! First we climb up Mt. Fuji, then we eat eggplants at the top, and finally we go down by skydiving with hawks!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: YEAH! It'll be awesome! Hold on, I gotta go buy climbing shoes.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I catch her attention just in time before she dashes off.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Huh? What's wrong? Oh! You need a pair too?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: If she's so desperate to take action, I should probably direct that energy into something more productive.
choice_data_list: Let's come up with a signature finishing move!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: A marathon… Cool! That sounds fun!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: I read a manga about marathons! The way they always ran the whole distance without giving up… Seizing victory at the last second…

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Sob… Waaah! It was so moving! I won't give up either!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It isn't what I was expecting, but this is how my new year with Winning Ticket begins.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Save my strength? You mean, like, rest?!
choice_data_list: Rest is an important part of your training!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Ohh, I see! Then I gotta nail resting too!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Okay—in that case, it's time for a nap!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Winning Ticket promptly plops down on my desk chair, and…

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Zzz! Zzz!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She even falls asleep with enthusiasm!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It isn't what I was expecting, but this is how my new year with Winning Ticket begins.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: A flashy finisher?! That's fire!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: I've always thought it'd be sweet to have one! Okay, let's do it!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: I wanna zoom real fast, like a cheetah! Then I'll be able to pass right through everybody else!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It isn't what I was expecting, but this is how my new year with Winning Ticket begins.
